QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Cannon Support
QuestInfo.1:
The Luminous Giant is trying to end the world. Stop the giant by charging and firing the cannons. The giant is vulnerable immediately after it uses the Light of Annihilation. Charge the cannons with Erda, and then report to #b#p3003564##k to complete the Expedition mission.

The cannons can only be charged #bfor a limited time#k, #bimmediately after the Luminous Giant uses the Light of Annihilation#k. Attacks after that cause the cannons to lose their charge. Erda accumulates when you attack monsters, so collect that Erda quickly to charge the cannons before the attack. Once the cannons are charged, they can be fired to deal damage to the giant.

#rThis mission is extremely difficult and dangerous. Be especially wary of the giant's Light of Annihilation and Light of Judgment attacks.#k
QuestInfo.2: You charged the cannons with Erda and completed the Expedition mission.
